items.title: 71542_Bill Coleman autobiographical manuscript
items.q: The other two trumpets were Bobby Cheeks and John Brown. ... I had rejoined it.

ctx.x: We doubled in some theaters including the Lafayette and that was hard work because we would be in the theaters all day from 11 a.m. until 11 at night and then have to come to the Inn and do two shows. We were paid on time for doing the shows but not at the Inn and each week Connie was getting deeper in debt to the band and the other folks in the show.

Russell's band had changed musicians considerably. Paul Barbarin had come back from New Orleans, Pops Foster was still in the band and I had rejoined it. The other two trumpets were Bobby Cheeks and John Brown. The sax
section consisted of Glyn Pague and Henry 'Moon' Jones on altos, Bingie Madison tenor. Jimmy Arckey was still there on trombone and Lee Blaire played guitar.
